title: Hours-Long Russian Drone Raid on Kyiv Kills 1, Damages Embassies and St. Volodymyr's Cathedral
detail: A Russian drone attack on Kyiv lasting several hours on Nov 19 killed a 26-year-old man in Podilskyi district and injured five others. Debris and a drone damaged the Dutch Embassy (Podilskyi) and Austrian Embassy (Shevchenkivskyi), cars and a security post nearby, and St. Volodymyr's Cathedral, where cornices were damaged and windows shattered; preliminary assessment found no damage to murals or structure. Separately, Ukraine's Air Force reported 98 drones plus Onyx anti-ship missiles launched overnight into Nov 19 (figures from a rolling live report; may change).
